title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
description: Tender, juicy baked meatballs simmered in a simple tomato sauce and served over spaghetti with Parmesan and basil.

image.alt: A plate of spaghetti with meatballs in tomato sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven} and line the baking sheet with foil. Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for {time 5 min}; this is what keeps the meatballs soft.
Add the beef, pork, egg, Parmesan, garlic, parsley and salt and mix gently with your hands just until combined. Roll into {count 18} balls about {len 1 1/2 in} across and set them on the sheet.
Bake until browned, {time 15 min}. They’ll finish cooking in the sauce.
Meanwhile warm the oil and sliced garlic in the deep skillet over medium heat until the garlic is pale gold, {time 2 min}. Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for {time 10 min}.
Add the meatballs to the sauce and simmer gently, turning them now and then, until cooked through, {time 20 min}. They should reach {temp 160F internal}. Stir in the basil.
Cook the spaghetti in a big pot of salted boiling water until al dente, drain and toss with some of the sauce. Serve with meatballs, more sauce and Parmesan.

notes: Freeze baked meatballs in their sauce for up to 3 months.
